notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - you can now add it to your Steam wishlist!
notes.content:
[h1]A few words about our latest project - Espresso Tycoon[/h1]

Our work on the Dreamjob: Programmer game is in full swing, however, today we want to show you something different. From now on you can add our newest project - Espresso Tycoon - to your Steam wishlist. But what is Espresso Tycoon? What does gameplay look like? And why should you give it a try? Let’s find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/51486114b2907bc31296ce941444a6285a0becf2.gif[/img]

[h2]A new twist of the good old Tycoon games[/h2]

Espresso Tycoon is a brand-new approach to the old, wonderful tycoon games you remember from your childhood. You will deal with hardcore management and an economy full of variable structures, connections, and solutions. Only the best of the best will be able to build a successful coffee business – and possibly a whole coffee empire.

Soon you'll be able to see what it's like to run your own coffee shop - [b]we plan to release a demo of the game later this year.[/b]

[h2]Why do we call it next-gen tycoon?[/h2]

The answer is simple - it's all about cool features. In Espresso Tycoon you can influence every, even the smallest aspect of your business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/1502e14033600bc07ccf5111c67223a619cd0e3b.png[/img]

You decide in which area you want to open your coffee shop, it is you who choose your target group of customers, you create the coffee, you set prices, working hours, hire employees, take care of the supply chain... making a long story short - everything is in your hand!

Imagine all this surrounded by beautiful, realistic graphics, pleasant sound effects, music, and a transparent UI - this is Espresso Tycoon.

[h2]What will you do?[/h2]

When talking about features, we cannot do without a few examples, can we? See what interesting mechanics and solutions will help you run a coffee business.

[list]
[*] Highly developed 3D coffee editor
[*] Highly developed brand editor
[*] Extensive location selection system
[*] Huge decorating and item placing possibilities
[*] PR and marketing
[*] Highly developed customer’s profile
[*] Tens of missions
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/e3fd3346965512ad06593a0855d520781b5d4d13.gif[/img]

[h2]Add Espresso Tycoon to your wishlist[/h2]

If you think Espresso Tycoon is the game for you, be sure to add it to your Steam wishlist. 
We also encourage you to help us build the game community and share your feedback. Chat, share your opinions and just have fun with other coffee lovers - all this on our Steam page and Discord server!

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Engame missions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/69a1457016b051c2e97db974fffbe3b8e876f6f5.png[/img]

[h1]What tasks are waiting for the best devs?[/h1]

Earlier, we wrote about things like your first job in the game or the basics of coding itself. However, Dream Job: Programmer has much more to offer. You will soon become fluent in programming and discover all the secrets of visual coding  - after all, that's what our game is all about! But wait, there's more...


[h2]Space agency needs you![/h2]

In addition to many exciting missions, such as helping the local police to catch a hacker gang, you will be asked to help the space agency! This is a real test of your skills. You will not only have to code all the technical aspects of the rocket launch, but also plan its start sequence and take care of the safety of astronauts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/a55f9cae9236081acc65a10f9a1bc230992a8b71.png[/img]

[h2]Actual Python coding skills[/h2]

To do this, you will have to use a coding language known as Python. You sure heard about it. No more blocks and no more lines to connect them - just pure coding. Make use of your knowledge, learn one of the most popular coding languages ​​and help the space agency achieve its goal!

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Experience Points and the Skill Tree
notes.content:
[h2]Experience points[/h2]

We are sure you know XP system from many other games in which character development is one of the main features. In most of them, you earn experience points by hitting milestones, completing tasks, or getting achievements. 

In Dreamjob: Programmer, you will be rewarded with them (in addition to cash and prestige!) after completing the jobs you signed for. Thanks to this, you will feel that as the game progresses, your character becomes a true master of coding. But is it only him/her?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/e435bb02f89460f19d1937c0ac03676c831fbcc4.gif[/img]

[h2]Skill tree[/h2]

Why is it worth developing your character's skill tree at all? Well, in addition to acquiring cool skills, it will make new kinds of tasks appear on your job board. For example, if you unlock the loops, the employers will find out about it, and commission you to work in this area. But there's more!

In Dreamjob: Programmer, we've improved the skill tree system, and we find it very exciting. In our game, you do the tasks. It is you who learn new things. And it is you who benefit from developing the skill tree the most. Unlock the most interesting skills and learn to use them along with your character!

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Upgrading your PC
notes.content:
[h1]All you need to know about upgrading a PC in Dreamjob: Programmer[/h1]

Every programmer knows that good hardware is essential. After all, nobody likes long-loading programs and stuttering screens. After making the appropriate improvements, your PC will run more smoothly and efficiently. Ok, it's time for an important question. Why is it worth spending money on updating your computer?

[b]Better computer guarantee:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Access to better, more demanding jobs
[*] Unlocking completely new types of jobs
[*] Prestige!
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/1d82ee0ce01c1ffe31f0a8418624a615ced1a04d.png[/img]

[h1]How do you upgrade your PC?[/h1]

It's simple! In the beginning, you have to complete a few tasks to earn some cash. The more you have, the better equipment you can buy! When you're ready, head over to the PC upgrade panel. There you will see various options to improve your computer - for example, you can replace your power supply, hard drive, RAM, cooling, or graphics card! All of them will affect the quality and comfort of your work!

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Visual Coding - the simplest way of programming
notes.content:
[h1]What is Visual Coding and how does it work?[/h1]

Visual Coding is a simple yet powerful tool that will help you understand the basics of programming. The whole thing is very transparent and easy to use even for people who have never written a line of the code in their lives.  Ok - but how does it work? Let's see!

[olist]
[*] Start by getting to know the properties of each block in your toolkit.
[*] Place the blocks in the right places and in the right order.
[*] Connect the blocks, so they can work together.
[*] Test your code and see if it works!
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/56a98ad5a6f780cab77d5a8cb28d30faa5c018e3.gif[/img]

[h1]Why Visual Coding is an ideal way to start?[/h1]

You don't need any code writing skills. You will create your first programs mainly using the mouse and your own mind. Simple tasks at the beginning of the game will make you get the basics in no time! If you want to understand the idea behind coding in languages ​​like Python, C ++, C #, Java, or JavaScript, then Visual Coding will be the perfect way to start!

notes.title: Feature Highlight: buying real estate. From garage to your own private island!
notes.content:
The main task of Dreamjob: Programmer game is to teach you coding, but let's not forget about other aspects! After all, this is a game that, in addition to learning, is meant to keep you entertained. And what's more fun in sim games than buying new properties?

[h2]Humble beginnings - garage or cozy room[/h2]

Nobody was born with amazing programming skills. It's something you have to learn. Therefore, your first office will be your garage or attic room. But don't worry! You can spend the money you earn on completing tasks on changing or improving it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/e6417dd7dc2cb0a5761f1b5d9c1b112b30770f5f.png[/img]

You can learn about the features of selected properties and their prices in a dedicated panel. At some point (as long as you learn to program well!) you will be able to buy your own yacht and work while sailing across the open seas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046517/047ef7f2e39f94a4a608e9acf689a210434c2e2b.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Your first tasks in Dreamjob: Programmer
notes.content:
[h1]Let's make some money![/h1]

Are you ready to accept your first job? Sure you are! Fortunately, programmers cannot complain about the lack of interesting offers.  Of course, you will start with something easy. Very easy. After all, we want you to get the basics.

[h2]Job Board[/h2]

There are always some interesting announcements on your job board. Choose a task that matches your skills and financial requirements - it's time test your skills. Each completed job will increase your pool of experience points and will give you some cash. You can spend them on developing your career... but that's a topic for another time!
